entries.title: Quarry survey: the Brackwater kiln
entries.body: Oswin Tarr relit the Brackwater kiln for the quarry survey samples. On the first of May Mira Feldane found a silver thimble in the kiln's ash pit. The samples go in the kiln tomorrow.

claims.subject: Mira
claims.quote: Mira found a silver thimble in the ash pit
